column2: 中古英语 holly ← holeliche，即 whole ＋ 副词后缀 -ly；与 holy 同形而异源
column3: completely, with nothing left out
column5: The claim is wholly without basis.|She was wholly responsible for the design.
column6: to the full extent, leaving no part out – 到尽处，一点不剩
column7: 完全地：程度上到顶|全部地：范围上一个不落

column2: 中古英语 why ← 古英语 hwȳ ← 原始日耳曼语 *hwī（凭什么）← 原始印欧语 *kʷey，是 *kʷís（谁）的工具格
column3: for what reason
column5: Why did you change your mind?|He never explained why he left.
column6: asking what stands behind a thing – 追问一件事背后是什么
column7: 为什么：口语里问缘由|为何：书面说法，义同

column2: 中古英语 wicked，是 wikke（邪恶的）的变体，更早词源不明；或出自古英语 wiċċa（术士）的形容词用法
column3: morally bad, or deliberately cruel
column5: The story has a wicked stepmother.|That was a wicked thing to do.
column6: bad on purpose, taking pleasure in harm – 存心为恶，且以害人为乐
column7: 邪恶的：品性上坏|恶毒的：出手狠，专拣要害

column2: 中古英语 wid ← 古英语 wīd（宽的、辽阔的）← 原始日耳曼语 *wīdaz ← 原始印欧语 *h₁weydʰh₁-（分开）
column3: measuring a lot from side to side
column5: The river is wide at this point.|She has wide experience in teaching.
column6: measuring much from one side across to the other – 从一边量到另一边距离大
column7: 宽的：横向尺寸大|广阔的：范围铺得开，多形容地或经验

column2: 由 wide ＋ spread 复合而成；wide 一支 ← 古英语 wīd（宽的）← 原始日耳曼语 *wīdaz
column3: found or happening over a large area
column5: There is widespread support for the plan.|Flooding was widespread that winter.
column6: reaching across a large area rather than one spot – 铺开到一大片，不止一处
column7: 普遍的：到处都有，不是个别|分布广的：所占的地域范围大

column2: 中古英语 widwe ← 古英语 widuwe ← 原始日耳曼语 *widuwǭ ← 原始印欧语 *h₁widʰéwh₂（寡妇），或出自 *weydʰ-（分开）
column3: a woman whose husband has died
column5: The widow sold the farm that autumn.|She was left a widow at thirty.
column6: a woman left alone by her husband's death – 因丈夫亡故而独自一人的女性
column7: 寡妇：日常说法|遗孀：偏书面，多用于正式场合

column2: 由 wide ＋ 抽象名词后缀 -th 构成，16 世纪末始见；此前用 wideness
column3: the distance from one side of something to the other
column5: Measure the width of the doorway.|The cloth comes in two widths.
column6: how far it is from one side across to the other – 从这一边到那一边有多远
column7: 宽度：横向的那个尺寸|幅宽：布料等成卷之物的横向宽度

column2: 中古英语 wyf ← 古英语 wīf（女子、妻）← 原始西日耳曼语 *wīb ← 原始日耳曼语 *wībą（女子）
column3: the woman a man is married to
column5: His wife teaches at the school.|She met his wife at the party.
column6: the woman joined to a man in marriage – 因婚姻与男方结成一对的那位女性
column7: 妻子：正式称法|太太：口语里对已婚女性的称呼

column2: 中古英语 wilde ← 古英语 wilde ← 原始西日耳曼语 *wilþī ← 原始日耳曼语 *wilþijaz（野的）
column3: living or growing in nature, not tamed or cultivated
column5: Wild deer graze on the hillside.|The crowd went wild at the final whistle.
column6: living outside human keeping, and behaving so – 不在人的管束之内，行事也就没了约束
column7: 野生的：自然生长、未经驯养|荒芜的：土地无人耕作而任其自生|狂暴的：不受约束到近乎失控

column2: 古英语 willende，是 willan（愿、要）的现在分词；即 will ＋ -ing
column3: ready to do something without being forced
column5: She is willing to work weekends.|We need willing hands for the move.
column6: ready to act because one chooses to – 出于自己愿意而肯动手
column7: 愿意的：肯做，不推拒|乐意的：不但肯做，还高兴去做

column2: 中古英语 winnen ← 古英语 winnan（劳作、争斗）← 原始日耳曼语 *winnaną（争、得）← 原始印欧语 *wenh₁-（求、欲）
column3: to come first in a contest, or to gain something by effort
column5: They won by two goals.|She won a place at the college.
column6: coming out ahead after a struggle – 争过一场之后落在前头
column7: 赢：在比赛或较量中占先|获胜：正式说法，义同|赢得：靠努力取得某物或某种评价

column2: 中古英语 wynd ← 古英语 wind ← 原始日耳曼语 *windaz ← 原始印欧语 *h₂wéh₁n̥tos（风），出自 *h₂weh₁-（吹）的现在分词
column3: air moving across the land or sea
column5: A cold wind blew off the sea.|The wind dropped after midnight.
column6: air on the move, felt but not seen – 流动着的空气，看不见但感觉得到
column7: 风：流动的空气|风力：它所带的那份力量

column2: 中古英语 wyndowe ← 古诺尔斯语 vindauga（字面「风眼」），即 wind ＋ eye；取代了古英语 ēagþȳrel（眼洞）
column3: an opening in a wall fitted with glass
column5: Open the window to let air in.|Rain streaked the window all night.
column6: an opening in a wall that lets in light and air – 墙上开的口，让光和空气进来
column7: 窗：那个开口及其框架|窗户：日常说法，义同

column2: 中古英语 wyn ← 古英语 wīn ← 原始日耳曼语 *wīną ← 原始印欧语 *wóyh₁nom（酒）；一说经拉丁语 vīnum 转入，两说未定
column3: an alcoholic drink made from grapes
column5: He opened a bottle of red wine.|The wine had turned to vinegar.
column6: a drink made by letting grape juice ferment – 让葡萄汁发酵而成的饮品
column7: 葡萄酒：以葡萄酿成的那种酒|酒：泛指时的简称

column2: 中古英语 winge ← 古诺尔斯语 vængr（翼）← 原始日耳曼语 *wēingijaz ← 原始印欧语 *h₂weh₁-（吹）；与 wind 同支，取代了本土词 fither
column3: one of the parts a bird or plane uses to fly
column5: The bird spread its wings.|Ice formed along the wing.
column6: the part pressed against air to lift the body – 压向空气、把身体托起来的那一部分
column7: 翅膀：鸟或虫身上用来飞的那对|机翼：飞机两侧起同样作用的那两片

column2: 中古英语 wynken ← 古英语 wincian（眨眼、示意）← 原始西日耳曼语 *winkōn（闭眼）← 原始印欧语 *weng-（弯、曲）
column3: to close and open one eye quickly as a signal
column5: He winked to show he was joking.|She gave me a quick wink.
column6: shutting one eye for an instant to pass a signal – 单眼一闭一睁，把意思递过去
column7: 眨眼：单眼快速开合这个动作|示意：靠这一下把意思传给对方

column2: 中古英语 winter ← 古英语 winter ← 原始西日耳曼语 *wintru ← 原始日耳曼语 *wintruz（冬）
column3: the coldest season of the year
column5: They spent the winter indoors.|Winter comes early in the north.
column6: the coldest stretch of the year – 一年里最冷的那一段
column7: 冬天：日常说法，指那段时节|冬季：把它当四季之一说，多用于书面

column2: 中古英语 wipen ← 古英语 wīpian（擦、抹）← 原始西日耳曼语 *wīpōn ← 原始印欧语 *weyp-（缠、绕）
column3: to clean or dry a surface by moving cloth across it
column5: Wipe the table before you set it.|He wiped the data from the disk.
column6: passing cloth across a surface to take what is on it off – 拿布在面上抹过，把上面的东西带走
column7: 擦：用布或手在表面抹过|抹去：把痕迹或记录去掉

column2: 中古英语 wir ← 古英语 wīr（金属丝）← 原始日耳曼语 *wīraz ← 原始印欧语 *weh₁iros（拧成的一股）← *weh₁y-（拧、编）
column3: a thin thread of metal
column5: Bend the wire into a hook.|A loose wire caused the fault.
column6: metal drawn out into a long thin thread – 金属被抽成细长的一股
column7: 金属丝：拉成细股的金属|电线：用来导电的那种，多包着绝缘层

column2: 中古英语 wisdom ← 古英语 wīsdōm ← 原始日耳曼语 *wīsadōmaz，即 wise ＋ -dom
column3: good judgement built up from experience
column5: He spoke with the wisdom of long practice.|They questioned the wisdom of the plan.
column6: judgement that experience has made sound – 由阅历磨出来的稳当判断
column7: 智慧：能看透事理的那份能力|明智：具体某个决定合乎道理

column2: 中古英语 wys ← 古英语 wīs（明智的）← 原始日耳曼语 *wīsaz（有见识的）← 原始印欧语 *wéydos（所见、所知）← *weyd-（看）
column3: showing good judgement
column5: It was wise to leave early.|She is wise in the ways of the trade.
column6: judging well because one has seen much – 见得多，所以判断得准
column7: 明智的：某个决定合乎道理|有见识的：识见广，看事透

column2: 中古英语 wisshen ← 古英语 wȳsċan（愿望）← 原始西日耳曼语 *wunskijan ← 原始日耳曼语 *wunskijaną ← 原始印欧语 *wenh₁-（求、爱）
column3: to feel that one would like something to happen
column5: I wish I had known sooner.|She made a wish before blowing out the candles.
column6: holding in mind something one would like to come true – 心里存着一件盼它成真的事
column7: 希望：盼着某事发生|心愿：心里存着的那件事本身|但愿：明知未必如此仍这么盼

column2: 中古英语 wit ← 古英语 witt（心智、理解力）← 原始日耳曼语 *witją（知识、理智）← *witaną（知）← 原始印欧语 *weyd-（看）
column3: quick clever humour, or intelligence
column5: His wit kept the table laughing.|She had the wit to say nothing.
column6: a mind quick enough to turn things on the spot – 脑子快到能就地把话头翻过来
column7: 机智：临事反应快、应对得当|风趣：说话有妙处，逗人发笑|才智：泛指心智上的能力

column2: 中古英语 wicche ← 古英语 wiċċe（女术士）与 wiċċa（男术士）← 原始日耳曼语 *wikkōną ← 原始印欧语 *weyk-（祝祭、分开）
column3: a woman thought to have magic powers
column5: The story ends with the witch defeated.|Villagers accused her of being a witch.
column6: a woman held to work harm by magic – 被认作以法术作祟的女人
column7: 女巫：施行巫术的女性|巫婆：口语说法，多带贬义

column2: 中古英语 withdrawen，即 with-（离、退）＋ draw（拉）；draw 一支 ← 古英语 dragan（拉）← 原始印欧语 *dʰregʰ-
column3: to take something back or move back
column5: He withdrew his application the next day.|She withdrew fifty pounds from the account.
column6: pulling back what had been put forward – 把伸出去的收回来
column7: 撤回：把已提出的收回|取出：把存进去的钱款取回|退出：从某处或某事中抽身

column2: 中古英语 withholden，即 with-（相对、逆）＋ hold（持）
column3: to refuse to give something that is due
column5: They withheld payment until the work was done.|He withheld his consent without explanation.
column6: holding back what the other side expects to get – 把对方等着要的按在手里不放
column7: 扣留：暂不发放、扣在手里|不予给出：拒绝给予同意或信息

column2: 中古英语 withinne ← 古英语 wiþinnan，即 with ＋ in
column3: inside, or not beyond a limit
column5: The keys were within the box all along.|Finish the report within two weeks.
column6: inside the bounds of something, not past them – 在某个界限里面，没有越过
column7: 在…之内：处在某个范围里|不超过：时间或数量不越过那条界

column2: 中古英语 withoute ← 古英语 wiþūtan（字面「在其外侧」），即 with-＋ out；取代了外来词 saunz（← 古法语 sans）
column3: not having or not using something
column5: He left without saying goodbye to anyone.|I would like tea without sugar, please.
column6: lacking the thing named – 缺着所说的那个
column7: 没有：不具备某物|不带：随身未携某物|不经：未经过某个步骤或许可

column2: 中古英语 withstanden ← 古英语 wiþstandan ← 原始西日耳曼语 *wiþistandan（抵住），即 with-（逆）＋ stand（立）
column3: to hold firm against force or pressure
column5: The wall withstood the flood.|Few materials withstand that heat.
column6: standing firm against what pushes at you – 顶着推来的力站住不动
column7: 抵住：把外力挡住不让其得手|经受：承受下来而不损坏

column2: 中古英语 witnesse ← 古英语 ġewitnes，即 wit（知）＋ -ness；wit 一支 ← 原始印欧语 *weyd-（看）
column3: a person who saw something happen, or to see it
column5: Two witnesses came forward the following morning.|She witnessed the whole accident from her window.
column6: one who saw it and can say so – 亲眼看见、说得出来的那个人
column7: 证人：能作证的那个人|目击：亲眼看见这件事|见证：在场看着某事发生并可为之作证
